description: Last price, 24h change, high, low and quote volume from Binance spot (Bybit fallback) for up to 20 symbols such as BTC,ETH,SOL. Quote currency defaults to USDT. 0.001 USDC per call via x402.

paymentProof.description: Payment proof: USDC tx hash on Polygon or Base (0x...) or Solana tx signature. Omit on the first call to receive the 402 payment instructions, pay, then call again with the proof.

symbols.description: Comma separated base symbols, e.g. BTC,ETH,SOL (max 20)

name: crypto_price
